wikipedia.pt: União Nacional para a Independência Total de Angola

names: União Nacional para a Independência Total de Angola
National Union for the Total Independence of Angola
summary: The third Angolan movement, founded in 1966 with a base in the centre and south of the territory; a signatory of the Alvor Agreement and, after 1975, the main armed opposition to the MPLA government.
